_about: Shared cases for the read-only Cypher check: wikipulse/qa/cypher.py (tests/qa/test_cypher_cases.py) and its JavaScript port site/cypher-check.js (tests/test_demo_graph_js.py) must both pass every one (spec 13a). Each validate case has max_rows (default 25) and one expectation: equals, startswith, endswith, ok (accepted, any text) or error (a regular expression the message must contain). Each bind_times case gives the query and the expected text after the time parameters are wrapped in datetime().

validate.query: MATCH (ev:Event) WHERE ev.started_at >= $today_start RETURN ev.key AS event_key
validate.equals:
MATCH (ev:Event) WHERE ev.started_at >= $today_start RETURN ev.key AS event_key
LIMIT 25

validate.query: MATCH (ev:Event) WHERE ev.started_at >= $today_start RETURN ev.key AS event_key LIMIT 10
MATCH (ev:Event) WHERE ev.started_at >= $today_start RETURN ev.key AS event_key LIMIT 1000
MATCH (ev:Event) WHERE ev.started_at >= $today_start RETURN ev.key AS event_key LIMIT $n
MATCH (n) WITH n LIMIT 5 MATCH (n)--(m) RETURN m.name

UNION
